name: Otto Merz
features: fair skin, close-cropped dark hair, small deep-set eyes, heavy square jaw, thick neck, enormous barrel-chested build, huge hands, impassive expression
bio: The colossus of the Mercedes team, a man who drove nails through planks with his bare hands and could lift the back of a racing car unaided. He won the 1927 German Grand Prix at the Nürburgring and was second there the following year, after victories at Solitude in 1925 and 1926. Before all that he had been a chauffeur in Franz Ferdinand’s Sarajevo motorcade in 1914. He was killed practising for the 1933 Avusrennen.
